description: Source code for map calculation and prefix matching in IPv6 network configuration, including functions for handling prefix comparison, memory copying, and rule parsing.

methods.name: bmemcmp
methods.description: Compare two memory blocks up to a specified number of bits.

methods.name: bmemcpy
methods.description: Copy memory blocks up to a specified number of bits.

methods.name: bmemcpys64
methods.description: Copy bits from one memory block to another, handling 64-bit aligned data.

methods.name: handle_dump
methods.description: Handle ubus dump request and store interface data.

methods.name: match_prefix
methods.description: Match IPv6 prefix against a list of interface attributes and update prefix data.
